repository.name: homestay
repository.scope_note: Catalog derived only from repository source and installed package metadata. No database connection was made and no production documents were read.

confidence_definitions.high: Directly declared in an explicit Mongoose schema, a route/controller assignment, or library source that is installed in this repository.
confidence_definitions.medium: Strongly implied by application code, seed data, or a library default, but not declared by an application-level schema in this repository.
confidence_definitions.low: Inferred from usage or naming only; the exact deployed shape may differ.
confidence_definitions.unknown: Not determinable from the repository without database access or production configuration.

structure_source_definitions.explicit_schema: Fields and constraints are declared in a Mongoose schema file.
structure_source_definitions.explicit_schema_plus_library_fields: The application declares a Mongoose schema, and an installed library (for example passport-local-mongoose) adds additional fields or indexes.
structure_source_definitions.seed_data: Fields are visible in the seeding data, but may not all be enforced by a model.
structure_source_definitions.inference: Fields are inferred from route handlers, controllers, views, or query usage rather than a schema.
structure_source_definitions.library_defined: Document shape is created by an installed library rather than an application model.

conventions.collection_naming: Mongoose default pluralization and lower-casing of model names. Verified model names are Listing, Review, User; the session store uses the connect-mongo default collection name.
conventions.object_id_serialization: MongoDB ObjectIds are serialized as strings by Mongoose toJSON/virtuals and by EJS rendering. The API migration must preserve string IDs.
conventions.timestamps: No application model declares timestamps: true. Only reviews have an application-managed createdAt. Sessions have library-managed expires and lastModified fields.
conventions.validation_layers: Mongoose constraints are the persistence layer. Joi schemas in schema.js validate HTTP form bodies only; they do not protect the seeder or direct database writes. passport-local-mongoose adds authentication fields and a username uniqueness constraint.
conventions.sensitive_data_policy: This catalog lists field names and shapes only. It intentionally contains no API keys, passwords, hashes, session identifiers, connection strings, or real user records.

collections.name: listings
collections.purpose: Accommodation listing. Stores display content, nightly price in INR, Cloudinary image reference, GeoJSON point, category, owner reference, and references to its reviews.

createdAt.reason: Schema does not declare timestamps: true.

updatedAt.reason: Schema does not declare timestamps: true.

fields.name: description
fields.notes: Required for HTTP create/update through Joi, optional for direct Mongoose writes.

fields.name: image
fields.notes: Because this is a nested path rather than a subdocument schema, it has no separate _id. Application code assumes image and image.url are present in index, show, and partial views.

fields.name: image.url

evidence.detail: req.file.path is written to image.url on update

fields.notes: Can be a Cloudinary HTTPS URL or a repository-local /images/*.png path from seed data. Not validated as a URL.

fields.name: image.filename

evidence.detail: filename and url from multer/Cloudinary are assigned on create

fields.notes: Cloudinary public identifier used only for storage; no asset deletion logic exists.

fields.name: price

evidence.detail: price is formatted as INR per night

fields.notes: No schema minimum, maximum, or currency field. Seed range is 4,000 to 100,000. Integer enforcement exists only in the Joi HTTP validation layer.

fields.name: location
fields.notes: Free text. Used by regex searches in AI tools and by MapTiler forward geocoding.

fields.name: country
fields.notes: Free text. AI prompts specifically instruct the model to expand country abbreviations, but the data itself has no country-code field.

fields.name: geometry

evidence.detail: geometry: { type: { enum: ['Point'], required: true }, coordinates: { type: [Number], required: true } }

fields.notes: GeoJSON Point. There is no parent-level required flag, but the nested required type and coordinates paths make geometry effectively mandatory under Mongoose document validation (validated even when geometry is absent). Raw/legacy MongoDB documents may still omit it because MongoDB does not enforce the schema. No 2dsphere index is declared.

fields.name: geometry.type
required_by: mongoose (nested required path; validated even when geometry is absent)

evidence.detail: type: { type: String, enum: ['Point'], required: true }

fields.name: geometry.coordinates
required_by: mongoose (nested required path; validated even when geometry is absent)

evidence.detail: coordinates are passed directly to MapLibre as map center

fields.notes: No length, range, or GeoJSON validator. Seed data uses [longitude, latitude]. The MapTiler forward-geocoding result is stored directly, with no application validation of coordinate ranges.

fields.name: category

evidence.detail: category: { type: String, required: true, enum: CATEGORIES }
single source of truth CATEGORIES array

fields.notes: Data contains all 11 categories, but the new and edit EJS forms expose only 8 of them. Editing a Hill Station, Heritage Homestay, or Houseboat listing causes the current category not to match any selected option.

fields.name: review

references.relationship: one-to-many, stored as an array of references

evidence.detail: new review is pushed onto listing.review

fields.notes: This is an array of references, not embedded review subdocuments. There is no database foreign key. Duplicate references are possible. A missing referenced Review produces a populate null and can break the averageRating virtual.

fields.name: owner
fields.notes: Not required by the schema, but always assigned by the HTTP create path and the seeder. isOwner middleware assumes owner exists and calls listing.owner.equals(...), which throws if owner is missing.

fields.name: __v

evidence.detail: No versionKey: false option; Mongoose default applies

fields.notes: Mongoose internal document version key. Not part of the business schema.

virtual_fields.name: averageRating
virtual_fields.formula: If review is empty, null. If review[0].rating is undefined (not populated), null. Otherwise sum(rating) / review.length, formatted with toFixed(1), therefore a string such as '4.5'.
dependencies: review array must be populated with Review documents
virtual_fields.notes: Because toFixed(1) returns a string, API consumers should expect a string, not a number. It is available only when the caller populates review. The AI search partial uses Listing.find without populate, so it does not display ratings.

relationships.on_delete: Listing post(findOneAndDelete) deletes all referenced Review documents

cascades.notes: Only runs through Mongoose findOneAndDelete middleware. Direct MongoDB deletes bypass it. Cloudinary assets are not deleted.

constraints.notes: Nested required paths are validated by Mongoose even when the parent geometry object is absent, so new/validated listing documents cannot omit geometry. Raw MongoDB writes bypass this.
These are required by Joi on create/update but optional in the Mongoose schema.

data_dependencies: Views listings/index.ejs, listings/show.ejs, and includes/listing.ejs assume image.url and price exist.
Show view assumes owner is populated and owner.username exists.
Review cards assume each populated review has an author with username.
Map view supplies geometry.coordinates or a hard-coded fallback of [77.209, 28.6139].
AI search and chat tools read title, location, country, price, category, and populated review fields.
notes: Seed data contains 49 listings across all 11 categories, with 185 generated reviews in total and 3 or 4 reviews per listing.
Seed images use 21 local /images/*.png assets and 28 remote image URLs.
No pagination or server-side category filter exists; the index loads every listing and populates all reviews.
No text index, category index, price index, owner index, or 2dsphere geometry index is declared.

collections.name: reviews
collections.purpose: Guest review for a listing. Stores a 1-5 rating, comment, creation date, and author reference. The listing-to-review relationship is stored on the Listing document, not on the Review.

updatedAt.reason: Schema does not declare timestamps: true.

fields.name: rating
fields.notes: Mongoose does not enforce integer, only the Joi route layer does. The review form's 'no-rate' radio is checked and has value 1, so submitting without choosing a star still stores a rating of 1.

fields.name: createdAt

evidence.detail: Seeder overrides createdAt with a random past date

fields.notes: Only review creation time exists; there is no updatedAt. Seed dates are random between six months ago and now.

fields.name: author
fields.notes: Not required by Mongoose but assigned by the HTTP create path and seeder. Show view assumes author is populated and has a username.

relationships.cardinality: many-to-one conceptually, but not stored on Review
relationships.on_delete: Listing deletion deletes referenced reviews; deleting a review pulls its ID from the listing
relationships.notes: A Review document cannot be traced to its listing without scanning listings.review. This prevents efficient listing-scoped review queries and allows orphan Review documents.

cascades.action: Delete all Review documents whose _id is in the listing's review array
Pull reviewId from the supplied listingId, then delete the Review document
cascades.notes: The handler does not verify that the review belongs to the supplied listingId. This can leave a dangling reference on the review's real listing.

constraints.notes: Mongoose allows missing rating and comment for direct writes.

data_dependencies: Listing.review[] is the only listing association.
Views/listings/show.ejs populates review.author and dereferences author.username.
AI getListingReviews tool populates review and returns rating/comment; it does not need author.
Average rating is computed in application code from populated reviews; it is not stored.
notes: Seed review pool has 46 unique review texts; the seeder creates 185 review documents by reusing pool entries.
Review create is not transactional: the review is saved before the listing array is saved.
Review delete is not transactional: the array pull and document delete can diverge.
No review text length limit, moderation flag, edit path, or unique-per-user-per-listing constraint exists.

collections.name: users
collections.purpose: Local username/password account. passport-local-mongoose adds username, password hash, and salt fields and the authentication behavior.

createdAt.reason: Schema does not declare timestamps: true; plugin does not add timestamps by default.

updatedAt.reason: Schema does not declare timestamps: true; plugin does not add timestamps by default.

lastLogin.reason: passport-local-mongoose lastLoginField is only added when limitAttempts is enabled; default limitAttempts is false.

fields.name: email

validation.application: HTML input type=email on signup; no server-side email format or uniqueness validation

evidence.detail: email is passed to new User({ email, username })

fields.notes: Not unique, not indexed, not used for login. Duplicate emails are possible. No email verification or password reset flow exists.

fields.name: username

validation.application: No length, character, or format validation; Passport LocalStrategy uses username as the login identifier

evidence.detail: defaults: usernameField 'username', usernameUnique true, hashField 'hash', saltField 'salt'
username input is required only in HTML

fields.notes: Unique index is case-sensitive because usernameLowerCase and usernameCaseInsensitive default to false. A missing username is possible at the Mongoose layer but the registration path rejects it.

fields.name: hash

validation.passport-local-mongoose: PBKDF2-SHA256, 25,000 iterations, 512-byte key length, hex encoding by default

evidence.detail: hashField is String with select: false; default PBKDF2 parameters

fields.notes: Sensitive credential material. Never export, log, or synthesize this field. Excluded from queries unless explicitly selected.

fields.name: salt

evidence.detail: saltField is String with select: false

fields.notes: Sensitive credential material. Never export, log, or synthesize this field.

indexes.name: username unique index (generated name not declared in application source)
indexes.notes: Mongoose will normally create a username_1 index when autoIndex is enabled. Production index presence and name are unknown.

relationships.on_delete: No cascade; deleting a User is not implemented and would leave listing.owner references dangling
No cascade; deleting a User is not implemented and would leave review.author references dangling
No cascade; sessions remain until TTL or logout
relationships.notes: Passport serializes the username (not the _id) into the session. It is stored inside the encrypted session payload, not as a top-level indexed field. Exact payload shape is library-defined.

data_dependencies: Listing.owner and Review.author populate into user documents; views dereference username.
Session passport.user stores the username and resolves to users.username.
No user deletion, profile editing, password reset, or email verification path exists.
notes: There is no admin role or role field.
The seeder creates 10 synthetic users with @example.com addresses and a shared sample password. Sample credentials must not be reused in any deployed environment.
The plugin's password validator default accepts any password; no password policy is configured.

collections.name: sessions
collections.purpose: Express session store managed by connect-mongo. Holds the encrypted express-session payload, including the serialized Passport username and flash/redirect state.

createdAt.reason: connect-mongo timestamps option defaults to false; app.js does not enable it.

updatedAt.reason: connect-mongo timestamps option defaults to false; app.js does not enable it.

lastModified.notes: Present because app.js sets touchAfter to 24 hours.

fields.name: _id
fields.default: session ID (SID), normally the signed express-session ID value
fields.notes: Sensitive session identifier. Do not synthesize or expose.

fields.name: session

validation.connect-mongo: serialize(session) with stringify=true, then encrypt with the crypto adapter (AES-256-GCM via kruptein) using SECRET

evidence.detail: collectionName defaults to 'sessions'; stringify defaults to true
MongoStore.create with mongoUrl, crypto secret, touchAfter

fields.notes: Ciphertext string produced by connect-mongo's crypto adapter. app.js sets crypto.secret, so the serialized session is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage. Treat as highly sensitive. The exact plaintext payload depends on Passport, connect-flash, and application middleware.

fields.name: expires
fields.default: cookie.expires if present; otherwise now + ttl (default 1,209,600 seconds / 14 days)

evidence.detail: cookie expires/maxAge is seven days, so stored expires is normally the cookie expiry

fields.notes: Application cookie lifetime is 7 days; library fallback TTL is 14 days. MongoDB TTL reaper runs approximately every 60 seconds.

evidence.detail: lastModified is set on set/touch when touchAfter is positive

inferred_nested_payload.format: JSON serialized session state before encryption; the stored session field is AES-256-GCM ciphertext

fields.name: sameSite
fields.notes: Not set by app.js; express-session default applies.

fields.name: user
fields.notes: Serialized username (passport-local-mongoose serializeUser); resolves via users.username, not users._id.

keys.name: saveRedirectUrl
keys.notes: Set by isLoggedIn on protected route access; not cleared after use.

inferred_nested_payload.unknown_keys: Additional keys may exist from express-session, Passport, or future middleware. Exact deployed payloads are not known.

indexes.name: expires_1
indexes.notes: Index name is generated by MongoDB; production presence is expected but not directly verified.

relationships.on_delete: No cascade; TTL removes expired sessions

data_dependencies: Every authenticated request depends on the session document and its serialized Passport username.
Flash success/error messages depend on connect-flash data inside the session.
Protected-route redirect behavior depends on session.saveRedirectUrl.
notes: This collection is not a business model and should not be exposed through the public API.

Session documents are encrypted by connect-mongo's crypto adapter using SECRET (AES-256-GCM via kruptein) at the session-field level. This is not full-database encryption and does not replace MongoDB storage encryption.
A FastAPI migration cannot assume it can reuse Express session cookies without deliberately reproducing cookie signing and session serialization.

relationships.name: listing_reviews
relationships.on_delete: listing findOneAndDelete hook deletes referenced reviews

relationships.name: session_user
relationships.on_delete: TTL expiry only; no user-delete cascade
relationships.notes: Passport serializes the username, not the _id. Stored inside an encrypted session payload, not as an indexed top-level field.

missing_but_possible_future_indexes: 2dsphere on geometry (only if server-side geospatial queries are added)
text index on title/description/location/country (only if server-side text search replaces regex search)
index_summary.notes: No secondary indexes are declared. Adding indexes is a data/performance decision, not required to retain behavior.

missing_but_possible_future_indexes: unique email (requires data cleanup; duplicate emails may already exist)

non_persisted_state.name: ai_chat_conversation

shape.chatConversation: JSON array of { role: 'user'|'assistant', content: string }

non_persisted_state.notes: Per-tab, lost when the tab closes. No server-side conversation history or message IDs. No tool-call parts are stored; only final assistant text is retained.

non_persisted_state.name: ai_description_request
non_persisted_state.notes: Not persisted. No server-side validation before prompt interpolation.

non_persisted_state.name: ai_search_request
non_persisted_state.notes: Not persisted. Result is rendered EJS HTML, not a stored document.

environment_variables.name: ATLAS_DB_URL
environment_variables.purpose: MongoDB connection string used by the Express app and connect-mongo session store.
environment_variables.notes: Primary application database variable. Do not commit values.

environment_variables.name: ATLAS_DB
environment_variables.purpose: MongoDB connection string used only by the seed script.
environment_variables.notes: Inconsistent with ATLAS_DB_URL. Seeding fails if only ATLAS_DB_URL is set.

environment_variables.name: MONGO_URL
environment_variables.notes: Documented in README/env.example but not read by any application source file.

environment_variables.name: SECRET
environment_variables.purpose: express-session signing secret and connect-mongo session-payload encryption secret.
environment_variables.notes: Changing this invalidates existing session cookies.

environment_variables.name: NODE_ENV
environment_variables.purpose: Controls secure session cookie and dotenv loading behavior.
environment_variables.notes: When 'production', cookie.secure is true. No trust proxy setting exists.

environment_variables.name: MAPTILER_API_KEY
environment_variables.purpose: MapTiler forward geocoding on create/update and MapLibre style URL token on the show page.
environment_variables.notes: The key is intentionally exposed to the browser for MapLibre. Use a restricted public key in production, not a server secret with broad scope.

environment_variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environment_variables.purpose: Gemini API key read by the @google/genai client used for the description generator.
environment_variables.notes: @google/genai's node client resolves GOOGLE_API_KEY first, then GEMINI_API_KEY. Do not expose to the browser.

environment_variables.name: GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY
environment_variables.purpose: Gemini API key read by the @ai-sdk/google provider used by chat and natural-language search.
environment_variables.notes: Verified in @ai-sdk/google provider source. If only GEMINI_API_KEY is set, chat and search fail; if only this variable is set, description generation fails.

environment_variables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
environment_variables.purpose: Fallback Gemini API key read by @google/genai before GEMINI_API_KEY.
environment_variables.notes: Not referenced by application source. Presence in the deployed environment is unknown. If both GOOGLE_API_KEY and GEMINI_API_KEY are set, the library warns and uses GOOGLE_API_KEY.

environment_variables.name: PORT
environment_variables.notes: Documented but ignored; app.js hard-codes port 8080.
